positive.prompt: I have BDD scenarios and workshop notes from another process. Assess whether they are ready and tell me which Sirius workflow should take them next without rewriting them.
I have a completed change but do not know whether it needs a walkthrough, formal review, structural refactoring, or publication. Route it to one initial owner without executing the handoff.

Given this externally produced specification, decide whether it needs external idea refinement, use cases, quality-constraint specification, system recovery, or can go straight to an external or repository-native implementation process.

negative.prompt: Identify the actors, their goals, and the main and alternate use-case scenarios for this feature.
Advance this approved proposal through one risk-sized design iteration, validate it, commit once, and stop.
Design the Rust ownership, staged startup, rollback, cancellation, and cleanup lifecycle for this approved behavior.

evals.prompt: Assess these externally prepared story-map notes and acceptance scenarios, then recommend the next Sirius skill.
evals.expected_output: A concise readiness assessment that exposes material uncertainty and recommends one Sirius skill with a content-based rationale.
expectations: The assessment judges the content rather than the source method or external tool
The recommendation names one next skill and explains the readiness evidence or gap
Unresolved decisions and stop conditions remain visible
prohibitions: Do not rewrite the input into a new specification format
Do not invent missing requirements or silently claim approval
Do not create a standalone document unless durable handoff value justifies it

evals.prompt: Route this request to one owner: I have a commit I do not understand and want a paced, section-by-section explanation without review, edits, staging, or publication.
evals.expected_output: A concise initial route to walkthrough-me based on the requested comprehension outcome and read-only authority boundary.
expectations: The route selects walkthrough-me as the single initial owner
The rationale distinguishes paced comprehension from formal review or publication
The direct task does not require a requirements artifact or readiness inventory
prohibitions: Do not route to iterative-risk-driven-development merely because code is involved
Do not imply authority to review, edit, stage, commit, or publish
